subject: app-redef
title: S.PROJ.------APP.RDEF.
description: Chart on book p. 327 (R(AS)CM(I)-11). The arrow points to APP-REDEF (the title writes APP-RDEF), the second code of the title, so it is the subject; S-PROJ (source projection) is the partner. From the subject: INT (intention) and TR-DIFF. From INT: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From PHY-U-P: POL-DY (political dynamics). From TR-DIFF: COS-D (cosmic dictates). From COS-D: SCC-RT and a second TR-DIFF label (TR-DIFF-2). From SCC-RT: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From TR-DIFF-2: TR (transformation).
